# Newsletter

```{r, echo=FALSE}
source(here::here("packages", "scrapePackages.R"))

pkgs <- readr::read_csv(here::here("packages", "packages.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::filter(.data$dev == "ox") |>
  dplyr::select(!"dev")
start <- as.Date("2025-01-01")
end <- as.Date(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-01"))

commits <- getInfo(pkgs, "commits") |>
  dplyr::mutate(date = as.Date(date)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(package_name, date) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
issues <- getInfo(pkgs, "issues") |>
  dplyr::mutate(created_at = as.Date(created_at),
                closed_at = as.Date(closed_at))
pulls <- getInfo(pkgs, "pulls") |>
  dplyr::filter(target == "main") |>
  dplyr::mutate(created_at = as.Date(created_at),
                merged_at = as.Date(merged_at))

releases <- versionsDates(pkgs$package_name)

newsletter <- rev(seq(from = start, to = end, by = "month")) |>
  purrr::map(\(x) {
    start <- x
    end <- x + months(1) - 1
    title <- format(x, "%B %Y")
    releases <- releases |>
      dplyr::filter(.data$date >= .env$start & .data$date <= .env$end) |>
      dplyr::arrange(.data$date) |>
      addNews()
    activity <- pkgs |>
      dplyr::select(package_name) |>
      dplyr::left_join(
        commits |>
          dplyr::filter(.data$date >= .env$start & .data$date <= .env$end) |>
          dplyr::group_by(.data$package_name) |>
          dplyr::summarise(commits = sum(.data$n)),
        by = "package_name"
      ) |>
      dplyr::left_join(
        issues |>
          dplyr::filter(.data$created_at >= .env$start & .data$created_at <= .env$end) |>
          dplyr::group_by(.data$package_name) |>
          dplyr::summarise(new_issues = dplyr::n()),
        by = "package_name"
      ) |>
      dplyr::left_join(
        issues |>
          dplyr::filter(.data$closed_at >= .env$start & .data$closed_at <= .env$end) |>
          dplyr::group_by(.data$package_name) |>
          dplyr::summarise(closed_issues = dplyr::n()),
        by = "package_name"
      ) |>
      dplyr::left_join(
        pulls |>
          dplyr::filter(.data$merged_at >= .env$start & .data$merged_at <= .env$end) |>
          dplyr::group_by(.data$package_name) |>
          dplyr::summarise(merged_pr = dplyr::n()),
        by = "package_name"
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
        c("commits", "new_issues", "closed_issues", "merged_pr"),
        \(x) dplyr::coalesce(x, 0)
      ))
    
    list(title = title, start = start, end = end, releases = releases, activity = activity)
  })
```

## Subscribe to Our Newsletter (Not available yet)

```{=html}
<div id="email-form-wrapper">
  <form id="email-form" action="https://formspree.io/f/mnndrkyl" method="POST">
    <input 
      type="email" 
      name="email" 
      placeholder="Enter your email" 
      required
      style="padding: 0.5em; width: 250px; max-width: 100%;"
    >
    <button 
      type="submit"
      style="padding: 0.5em 1em; margin-left: 0.5em;"
    >
      Subscribe
    </button>
  </form>
  
  <div id="thank-you" style="display: none; padding-top: 1em; color: green;">
    ✅ Thanks for subscribing!
  </div>
</div>

<script>
document.getElementById("email-form").addEventListener("submit", async function(event) {
  event.preventDefault(); // Stop default form submission

  const form = event.target;
  const data = new FormData(form);

  const response = await fetch(form.action, {
    method: form.method,
    body: data,
    headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
  });

  if (response.ok) {
    form.style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("thank-you").style.display = "block";
  } else {
    alert("Oops! There was a problem. Please try again.");
  }
});
</script>
```
